text.en: Pet parents express complete confidence in Laoise, Oliwia, and the walking team, describing them as attentive, accommodating, and dependable. Clients appreciate that the walkers build strong bonds with dogs and handle individual needs with patience. Reviewers consistently highlight how reassuring it is to entrust both pets and home access to the crew.

Reviewers note that the team caters thoughtfully to pets of all temperaments, including energetic puppies, elderly dogs with heart conditions, and animals with rescue anxiety. Clients appreciate that daily medication is administered reliably and that both dogs and cats receive affection and individualized attention during walks and home sitting.

Dog owners emphasize that regular communication gives them complete peace of mind while away at work or traveling abroad. Reviewers praise the daily photo updates and messages sent after each outing, showing pets happy and engaged on their walks. Families note that the prompt, friendly updates keep everyone closely informed.

a.en: OUTPAWS provides weekday dog walking, solo and group walks, puppy care, and tailored pet sitting services.

q.en: Do dog walkers send updates during walks?

a.en: Yes, reviewers consistently praise the daily photos and messages sent during each walking session.

q.en: Can the team manage pets requiring medication?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that walkers reliably administered daily heart medications and provided tailored care for elderly pets.
The service is based in Ballsbridge and serves surrounding Dublin neighbourhoods.
